name: FUN_WF_ACTIONS
description: This table contains data related to action(s) on rule.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Action identifier and primary key.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference identifier to the FUN_WF_RULES table.

columns.name: LIST_BUILDER_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of list builder to route the approval task.

columns.name: RESPONSE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Represents whether the response type is required. Possible values  are: Required and FYI.

columns.name: CALLABLE_FUNCTION
columns.description: Function name when assignment type is call operation.

columns.name: CALLABLE_FUNCTION_ARGUMENTS
columns.description: Comma separated list of arguments passed to a function that can be called.

columns.name: APPROVAL_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: Name of the approval group used in the approval rule.

columns.name: ALLOW_EMPTY_GROUP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether empty approval group is allowed.

columns.name: AT_LEAST_LEVELS
columns.description: Least number of job levels required for an approval notification to flow through the job or position hierarchy.

columns.name: AT_MOST_LEVELS
columns.description: Highest job level required for an approval notification to flow through the job or position hierarchy.

columns.name: AT_LEAST_RELATIVE_TO_CODE
columns.description: Least number of levels required for an approval notification to flow through the job or position hierarchy. These least number of levels are relative to job or position levels of the Creator, Absolute, and Starting point.

columns.name: AT_MOST_RELATIVE_TO_CODE
columns.description: Highest level required for an approval notification to flow through the job or position hierarchy. This highest level is relative to job or position levels of the Creator, Absolute, and Starting point.

columns.name: START_PARTICIPANT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Hierarchy provider function to build the hierarchy chain.

columns.name: START_PARTICIPANT_USER
columns.description: The first participant in the hierarchy of approval chain.

columns.name: START_PARTICIPANT_LB
columns.description: Type of list builder specified to build the hierarchy for approval chain.

columns.name: START_PARTICIPANT_HIER_TYPE
columns.description: Type of hierarchy used to find the next level approver.

columns.name: START_PARTICIPANT_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date as per the user time zone to find the first approver for an approval rule.

columns.name: TOP_PARTICIPANT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Hierarchy provider function to build the hierarchy chain.

columns.name: TOP_PARTICIPANT_USER
columns.description: Last user in the hierarchy list builder.

columns.name: TOP_PARTICIPANT_LB
columns.description: Type of list builder specified to build the hierarchy for approval chain.

columns.name: TOP_PARTICIPANT_HIER_TYPE
columns.description: Type of hierarchy used to find the top approver.

columns.name: TOP_PARTICIPANT_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date as per the user time zone to find the first approver for an approval rule.

columns.name: UTILIZED_PARTICIPANTS
columns.description: Determines how notification must flow in the job or position hierarchy.

columns.name: RESOURCE_LB_USERS
columns.description: Single user name or list of comma separated multiple users in the resource list builder.

columns.name: RESOURCE_LB_APPLICATION_ROLE
columns.description: Name of the application role in the resource list builder.

columns.name: AUTO_ACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether auto action is enabled.

columns.name: AUTO_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action to be performed when auto action is enabled.

columns.name: INCLUDE_MGR_AT_LAST_LEVEL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator to specify if task should be routed to all the managers at the last level of approval cycle.

columns.name: DIMENSION_ID
columns.description: Dimension identifier that denotes the functional object for which the approval rules is begin evaluated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Represents the type of action to be performed.

columns.name: ACTION_ORDER
columns.description: The order in which actions are stored for a rule.

columns.name: ACTION_PARAMETERS
columns.description: Used for capturing additional details of an action.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
